parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the toggle switches on the wall switch assembly, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning electrical circuits on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by a small angular displacement or press action to complete or break the circuit.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second toggle switch on the wall switch assembly, also made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of two devices or lights.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, toggling between on and off positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or faceplate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate for strength and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and insulation from electrical components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or mounting box.
